channel.title: Rippling Device Management (MDM) Launches
channel.description: Latest product launches for IT admins (scope: it-mdm)

item.title: 3 new S1 SKUs (Purple AI, Cloud Funnel, Vigilance MDR)
item.description: Three new SentinelOne SKUs are now available. • Purple AI, Cloud Funnel, and Vigilance MDR purchasable as part of the SentinelOne offering through Rippling

item.title: Remote Access (Mac)
item.description: Remote access for Mac devices is now available. • Remote into managed Mac devices from the admin console • Self-serve purchase available

item.title: Smooth Migration (Windows Entra)
item.description: Smooth migration is now available for Entra-joined Windows devices. • Migrate devices while keeping them connected to Entra • Path to converting Entra accounts to local accounts after migration

item.title: Mac migration for supervised devices
item.description: Mac migration now preserves supervised status during the move. • Migrate supervised Mac devices without losing supervision

item.title: Remote Access (Windows)
item.description: Remote access for Windows devices is now available. • Remote into managed Windows devices from the admin console • Complements the Mac remote access capability

item.title: Improved Software Experience
item.description:
Improved software deployment management • Easily view the status of software deployments across your organization • Quickly identify errors and issues with detailed explanations • Explore and manage software from an improved catalog experience
Better debugging and policy deployment visibility • Detailed error tracking for policy deployments • Clear insights into deployment failures to help admins quickly diagnose and resolve issues

item.title: Faster Software Installation Initiation
item.description: Faster software deployment • Significantly improved deployment speed across devices • New deployments now initiate within ~2 minutes of a device coming online

item.title: Revamped Device Enrollment Flow
item.description: Improved device onboarding experience • Streamlined the “add a device” flow for faster setup • Simplified trial account landing pages for a more intuitive experience • Makes it easier to get new devices up and running quickly on Rippling MDM

item.title: Granular user account management during device assignment
item.description: Granular device assignment controls • Choose what user accounts to keep • Choose what user accounts to delete • Choose whether or not to create a new account • Edit both the username and full name for the account • Pick a local user account that will become the network account (for Windows devices with network accounts enabled)

item.title: Smooth migration for Windows (non-Entra)
item.description: Simplified device migration to Rippling MDM • Quickly migrate devices with minimal steps for a seamless transition • Supports migration from existing Windows MDM solutions • Applies to devices not joined to Microsoft Entra • Makes it easier for customers to transition to Rippling MDM
